tokenName: Investment Management Commodity Income Fund Token
description: Investment Management manages a professionally curated portfolio of warehouse receipts from Namibia's commodity producers — maize, soybean, cotton, coffee and groundnuts. regulatoryFramework: Namibia Financial Markets Act; Namibia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Management Service Economy Fund Token

Retail investors earn managed returns while supporting service worker livelihoods.
regulatoryFramework: Namibia Financial Markets Act; Namibia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Management Infrastructure Income Fund Token

regulatoryFramework: Namibia Financial Markets Act; Namibia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Investment Management Labor Economics Fund Token

regulatoryFramework: Namibia Financial Markets Act; Namibia Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024
